'''2011 Tatooine Regionals Jerry Heine LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jerry Heine]] at [[2011 Tatooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)|VB4-L-watchyourstep-pre.gif}}
* '''Username:''' quesosauce37
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
